subject.title: feat(onboarding): recommend plugins and skills from installed apps

question: Should onboarding be allowed to send detected application names and bundle identifiers to the configured model and ClawHub by default before explicit user consent?
rationale: This is an intentional privacy and onboarding-policy choice with external data disclosure; source correctness alone cannot establish the repository's acceptable trust boundary.

options.title: Ask before external matching
options.body: Add a clear consent step before model or ClawHub requests and keep remote node sharing as a separate default-off control.

options.title: Retain default-on disclosure
options.body: Keep the current disclosure-only design, but require explicit owner approval plus concrete privacy, fresh-install, and upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Ask before external matching
recommendation.body: Add a clear consent step before model or ClawHub requests and keep remote node sharing as a separate default-off control.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR records this as an intentional onboarding product decision and is assigned to the same onboarding-area contributor.
